# Provenance

Synthetic workspace for the profiles extension integration tests; written for VSSlicer, no upstream bytes.
Layout cites OrcaSlicer@09aa0114 `resources/profiles/<Vendor>.json` + `<Vendor>/{machine,process,filament}/` (the vendor index lists sub-files) and the PrusaSlicer vendor bundle INI (`[vendor]`, `[printer_model:*]`, `[print:*]`, `[filament:*]`) as in PrusaSlicer@30ef591 `resources/profiles/PrusaResearch.ini`.
Licence: AGPL-3.0-or-later (same as the repository).
